_about: Ore veins in the Anaerobic Abyss (DeepDelve). Edit and save: new Abyss chunks use it at once, no restart.
Chunks already generated keep their ores. Delete this file to get the defaults back.
all_veins_multiplier: scales veins_per_chunk of every vein (0.5 = half as many veins, 2 = twice).
veins_per_chunk: veins in one Abyss chunk on average. 2.5 = two, plus a third half the time; 0.25 = one chunk in four.
ores: block id -> weight. Each block of a vein is picked by weight (zinc 3, lead 2 = three fifths zinc).
size_min / size_max: blocks in one vein (a random walk from a start just behind the cave's floor or ceiling).
in_sapropel: half of the veins go in the sapropel soil instead of the rock (siderite nodules).
Veins only replace the stratum's rock (and sapropel, if in_sapropel). An ore id that isn't registered is skipped.
